messages:
alex: Quick sync — finalizing design partner recruitment criteria, incentives, and feedback cadence.
alex: TL;DR: need a short list we can send to candidates by EOD. thoughts?
maria: +1. main ask: commitment 6 weeks, 2hrs/wk minimum, one integration call, 1 feedback session per release.
shiv: For devex, 2hrs/wk is tight. Can we say "min 1hr/week + milestone calls"? keeps it flexible.
carla: For incentives, proposing $2k credit (hosted), or $500 gift card + priority support. Keeps budget predictable.
sam: Suggest success metrics: feature adoption %, feedback quality (qual tags), and 2x engagement vs baseline.
jess: Also want a CS checklist: onboarding completion, 1st successful API call, weekly check-ins logged.
alex: ok adjust: 6 weeks, 1hr/week min + 2 milestone calls. Carla — $2k hosted credit or $500 gift card. any objections?
elaine: legal: need an easy DP NDA + data usage blurb. I'll draft a 1-paragraph consent and a short IP clause.
shiv: Feedback cadence — propose weekly short pulse (5 q) + biweekly deep interview. keeps burden low.
maria: Agreed. Weekly pulse can be a 3-min form. Put core eval: latency, correctness, integration pain.
carla: On recruiting criteria: target customers with existing LLM usage + product that needs low-latency inference.
carla: Prefer dev-forward companies (platform teams, search, chat experiences).
alex: Good. Can we agree on candidate scoring rubric? quick: Fit(1-5), Commitment(1-5), Impact(1-5). >=11 = go.
sam: I'll add tracking columns in the DP sheet and wire up a simple dashboard (engagement + NPS) — ETA Wed.
recruitment-bot: Added candidate list to sheet: https://docs.google.com/DP-recruiters (auto)
alex: Next: feedback loop. Weekly pulse -> auto-digest to #dp-feedback + product weekly summary. Deep interviews recorded (consent req).
jess: We'll own onboarding support and weekly sync notes. Product to send release notes + known issues before calls.
elaine: Also flag export controls + encryption for private deployments. Some customers will need KMS language.
carla: Do we want to offer priority bug fixes for dp customers? maybe SLA-lite for the program length.
alex: maybe "priority triage" not a formal SLA. We can promise faster response and curated rollouts.
shiv: For instrumentation: add opt-in telemetry flag and sample logs (scrubbed) for regressions. Consent required.
alex: Last ask — who can draft the candidate email + landing page copy?
carla: I'll draft email. Shiv can help with technical ask. Maria will review the commitment language.
alex: Great — let's aim to open recruitment Mon. I'll put a final doc in the DP folder: https://docs.google.com/DP-playbook
maria: :thumbsup:
carla: :rocket:
sam: Will prep dashboard metrics.
jess: I'll prep CS onboarding checklist.
elaine: Draft NDA in 24h.
alex: Thanks all — short follow-up in thread with links.
